name: Rotted board shield
notes: The Forgotten shield-bearer's guard (mw-ju8.19): a door plank and a rusted boss, held up by habit. A shieldless-style guard (kind weapon), so the knight's shield bash breaks it outright for a second (mw-e04.14) - the counter to a skeleton that out-waits a mashed light attack. Soaks 80% of slash and pierce but only 50% of blunt (wood splinters under a hammer) and nothing of fire (it is dry wood). Wide 110 degree arc, a slow 12-tick raise, half speed behind it. Skeletons have no stamina pool, so only a bash, a flank or fire gets through.
